svg.title: Youssef & Maii - Invitation card (ASSUMED trim 127 x 170.52 mm - TBC)
svg.desc: Magenta = trim; blue dashed = 3 mm bleed; green dotted = 5 mm safe area; magenta dashed ellipse = placement zone of the physical 3-D butterfly (NOT printed). | FOIL_GOLD layer = spot colour for metallic foil (display colour #A37A4E). FINAL DIELINE, PRINTABLE AREA, SCALE, BLEED AND SAFE AREA MUST BE CONFIRMED AGAINST THE MANUFACTURER'S TEMPLATE BEFORE PRODUCTION.
